stages.goal: Recognize and pronounce each Arabic letter in isolation.
Read initial, medial, and final forms of each letter.
Read letters with fatha, kasra, and damma.
Join a voweled letter to a sukoon letter.
Double the letter with shadda without swallowing it.
Hold natural madd for two counts.
Read common Quranic words from the Mushaf script.
Read short surahs accurately before tajweed theory.
